description: Get a site's Stunt Double Index report: how well AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and others) can find, understand and act on it. Returns the score out of 100, band, rank, category and provider scores, frictions, failing checks and when it was scored. A blocked or opted-out site has a null score with unscored_reason. Pass a domain, or a project_id for its linked domain. Use list_index_sessions to see why a category or provider scored low.

domain.description: The site to read, e.g. "example.com". A full URL is fine: protocol, path and a leading www. are dropped. Pass this or project_id, not both.

project_id.description: Project UUID, from list_projects. Uses the Index domain linked to that project instead of naming one; fails if the project has no linked domain. Pass this or domain, not both.

name: get_index_report

band.description: Score band: excellent, good, ok, poor or critical. Null when unscored.

applicable.description: False when the category does not apply and is left out of the overall.

claimed.description: Whether the site owner has claimed the domain.

frictions.description: Problems agents hit on the site. Empty for a site that opted out.

latest_probe.description: The latest HTTP probe and its failing checks. Null when none is available.

overall_score.description: Overall score out of 100. Null when the site is unscored.

previous_score.description: The overall score before the latest run.

rank.description: Leaderboard position, 1 is best. Null when unranked.

report_url.description: The public Index report page for the site, to link a person to.

unscored_note.description: A sentence explaining the unscored state, ready to relay. Null when scored.

unscored_reason.description: Why the site has no score: blocked, unreachable, opted_out or pending. Null when it is scored.

title: Get Index report
